acceptance.claim: On the Manage Template list there is a 'Create Template' button for each type (SMS, EMAIL, LETTER) that opens /enotification/create-template/<type>. The button is not wrapped in a function check, and the server mapping has dedicated create functions for EMAIL and SMS only, none for LETTER.
acceptance.missing: 'Not wrapped in a function check' and 'no create function for LETTER' are absences: grep of hasFunction in ocmsadminui/src/pages/ManageTemplate found nothing, and grep of CREATE_LETTER in api-authorization.properties found nothing; neither can be shown by one quote. Which roles hold the functions: cannot verify from repo. LETTER create goes through OCMS_ENOTIF_MANAGE_TEMPLATE (/v1/templatestore).

acceptance.claim: The form takes Template Name and the template body and saves with POST templatestore; the Template Type is set from the tab. The officer must type the _SMS/_EMAIL/_LETTER suffix; the UI only upper-cases the name. Saving a name that already exists silently overwrites that template (no duplicate check).

'Saving a name that already exists silently overwrites' is NOT shown by one line: it is inferred from repository.save(entity) on an entity whose @Id is the assigned templateName (EN lines 31-34, no @GeneratedValue) and the absence of any exists check in the create path; the /templatestoreexists endpoint is only named in a class comment. Behaviour not run. [Medium confidence]
acceptance.fix_en: The form takes Template Name and the template body (plus Remarks) and saves with POST templatestore; the Template Type is set from the tab and the UI upper-cases the name. The officer must type the _SMS/_EMAIL/_LETTER suffix (the UI only checks that the name contains the type). The create path calls repository.save on an entity keyed by templateName with no existence check, so saving an existing name is expected to overwrite that template (inferred from the code, not run).
